name: Danlaw Technologies India Ltd
tagline: Hyderabad-based automotive embedded software/telematics subsidiary of US-based Danlaw Inc, showing strong recent numbers (revenue +20.75%, PAT +112.95% YoY) but a near-silent VP thread flags real opacity: no clear articulation of the parent-subsidiary relationship, no proactive investor communication, and an unclear TAM beyond FASTags
business_overview: Incorporated 1992, Danlaw Technologies India provides engineering and software development consulting services and industrial electronics to the automotive and aerospace industries - connected-car/telematics, embedded/V2X testing software. ISO 9001:2015 and IATF 16949 certified. Subsidiary of Danlaw Inc. (US, founded 1984). Manufacturing facility in Goa, HQ Hyderabad. (Source: external-lead, @ankitbahuguna84, untrusted X triage, first_seen 2026-09-04 - flagged for a strong price run.)
fundamentals_table: ~Rs 244 Cr; 9M-FY26 net sales Rs 207.18 Cr (+20.75% YoY)
Operating profit +54.81% YoY; net profit +112.95% YoY
fundamentals_narrative: Genuinely strong recent numbers - revenue +20.75%, operating profit +54.81%, net profit +112.95% YoY - on a clean-ish balance sheet (Debt/EBITDA 0.76x).
